name: Spectrum SAX1V1K front light
author: Router Home contributors
description: Shows the internet status on the SAX1V1K's RGB front LED (red GPIO 25, green GPIO 32, blue GPIO 26): blue = internet through WAN, white = through a mobile modem, yellow = no internet, red = offline. OpenWrt only describes red and blue; until green is added to OpenWrt, it is switched with gpioset (installed automatically if missing).
